mapper.select: SELECT apr42_comment_id AS comment_id , apr42_person_id AS person_id , apr42_comment AS comment , ( '<'||'b'||'>'|| f_emp_kor_nm(apr42_person_id) ||' ('|| f_get_empTrans(apr42_person_id, apr42_date::date, 'org_code_nm') ||' '|| f_get_empTrans(apr42_person_id, apr42_date::date, 'pos_nm') ||') '|| '<'||'/b'||'>'|| TO_CHAR(apr42_date,'YY.MM.DD') ||' '|| apr42_time ) AS comment_full_str , ( SELECT '파일('||COUNT(sys10_file_id)||')' FROM sys10_file WHERE sys10_parent_id = apr42_comment_id ) AS file_str , ( CASE WHEN apr42_person_id = #{personId} THEN '✕' ELSE '' END ) AS delete_str FROM apr42_comment WHERE apr42_appr_id = #{apprId} AND apr42_company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY apr42_date, apr42_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO apr42_comment (apr42_comment_id, apr42_company_id, apr42_person_id, apr42_appr_id, apr42_date, apr42_time, apr42_comment) VALUES (#{commentId}, #{companyId}, #{personId}, #{apprId}, f_sysdate(), TO_CHAR(f_sysdate(), 'HH24:MI:SS'), #{comment})
